title: Expose every currently applicable host verification by criterion at one captured task/run basis
outcome: Complete applicable-verification discovery, split from the parent's original-closure and explicit older-note consumer. Depends on the separate Engram same-basis paged read w-674ea9b043aa; acceptance_binding_read v2 remains unchanged and computes no present freshness. acceptance: At one captured work revision and active-run cut, the brief indexes every currently applicable host verification candidate for each bound criterion with its full record id, check kind and validated provenance, including later checks and records beyond the notes window. Original closures, stale checks and non-holder records are not promoted as currently applicable. Request-path tests cover these cases and reject moving, wrong-run and partial query results. The exact reviewed input passes the maintained full gate.
